item.description:
## See what changed after an update
- The first time you open a new version, a sheet shows what's new in it, with a link to every release. - Steam games are found by the shared SteamKit: a game in two libraries shows once, a game with a damaged or nameless Steam file still shows, and Windows paths keep their backslashes.

## The same Help menu as every app
- **What's New in Starseed** opens the latest release notes. - **Report a Problem…** opens a new GitHub issue with the app version, build and macOS version already filled in. - **Check for Updates…** is always in the Starseed menu, greyed out when updates aren't available. - The mods' item is now **Check for Mod Updates**, so it isn't confused with app updates.

## Steadier downloads and installs
- A mod or SMAPI download that loses its connection, even for a Wi-Fi drop, picks up where it stopped, and a cut download never reaches the installer. - A mod archive that would write outside its folder is refused, and an install or restore that fails halfway leaves your Mods and saves as they were. - Installing mods, backing up saves and updating SMAPI can no longer hang on a tool with a lot to say. - The Storage page counts hard-linked files once, so the sizes match what the disk really holds. - A refused download now says the server's real error code.

## A better SMAPI Log
- The toolbar says how many messages it shows, and **Show All Messages** undoes every filter at once. - Pick any mod or source from the **Source** menu, not only the ones with problems. - After **Clear**, the log says when you cleared it and how many earlier messages are hidden. - An empty log says so plainly, instead of "No Matching Messages".

## A better SMAPI Log
- **Hide Repeats** folds a message SMAPI logs again and again into one line, with how many times. - Earlier SMAPI logs are in the **Log File** menu, next to the latest and crash logs, with **Open Logs Folder**. - **Copy Shown Messages** (⇧⌘C) copies just what the filters show; select lines to copy only those, or **Export Log…** to save the file. - With the Loaded Mods panel open, SMAPI's and the game's versions show as icons (named on hover) instead of being cut off.
